contract.intended_consumer: Agents and developers using installed Enforced Planning native hooks
contract.outcome: The default-on governance profile controls actual native enforcement, while one master false value suppresses governance blocks without deleting installed state or losing configured modes.

canonical_journey.starting_state: A disposable governed repository is installed with native hook consumers and configured enforce modes.
canonical_journey.input: The effective project profile, native prewrite and artifact gates, hook generation, plan validation, pre-commit behavior, and the master governance switch.
canonical_journey.action: Run native both-sign checks with the master absent, false, and restored true; also exercise stale-projection and restricted-bootstrap recovery.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Absent or true preserves configured enforcement, false makes every governed consumer non-blocking while preserving configuration, and recovery feedback names an admissible executable action.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: Any native consumer ignores master false, defaults the master off, rewrites configured modes, or recommends a recovery command that the same gate blocks.

request.approval_text: User authorized Plan 128 runtime consumer implementation
